name: Cockpit
tagline: Every project on one screen, with drift flagged before the monthly report.
problem: Boards see status reports weeks after problems begin.
how: Site imagery, cost, schedule and progress from existing systems
Measures progress against the twin, updates earned value, and compares every project with comparables and the approved case
Exceptions and priced recovery options, weeks earlier
features: Portfolio view: Every project and programme on one screen
Early warning: Spending shape against comparables at the same progress
Drift triggers: Cost and date drift against the investment case
Site Vision: Computer vision on drone, fixed-camera and 360-degree imagery, checked element by element against the twin’s plan for that date
Measured earned value: Schedule and cost performance indices from measured, not reported, progress
Single pane of glass: Cost, schedule, risk, safety, commitments and approved changes on one screen, for a project or a portfolio
Exception reporting: Nine leading indicators, read as percentiles
Recovery levers: Options priced against the cost of a day of delay
Readiness and safety: Readiness thresholds and safety performance in the same view
notes: The Project Intelligence Cockpit repository has no code yet, so there are no screens.
